changelog:
- Compatibility extended for Codex and LSP/gopls tools; new Go-specific tools (`godig`, `gopls`) enabled for richer package navigation and diagnostics.
- Explicit support for `paths` restricts skill invocation to Go files.
- Cross-references and usage notes updated to recommend dedicated Go tools and skills for documentation queries (pkg.go.dev via `godig`, code navigation via `gopls`).
- Metadata version bumped to 1.1.0.
- `skill-card.md` removed.
- Minor metadata, wording, and formatting improvements for clarity.
summary: In-memory caching in Golang using samber/hot — eviction algorithms (LRU, LFU, TinyLFU, W-TinyLFU, S3FIFO, ARC, TwoQueue, SIEVE, FIFO), TTL, cache loaders, sharding, stale-while-revalidate, missing key caching, and Prometheus metrics. Apply when using or adopting samber/hot, when the codebase imports github.com/samber/hot, or when the project repeatedly loads the same medium-to-low cardinality resources at high frequency and needs to reduce latency or backend pressure.
